title: Constellation buys Calpine for $16.4B equity ($26.6B net)

sources.quote: The cash and stock transaction will have a value of approximately $16.4 billion, composed of 50 million shares of Constellation stock using the trailing 20-day VWAP of $237.98 and $4.5 billion in cash plus the assumption of approximately $12.7 billion of Calpine net debt.

Significant Transactions and Developments Acquisition of Calpine Corporation On January 7, 2026, we acquired 100% of the outstanding equity of Calpine for a purchase price of approximately $22 billion.

explain: Constellation, the largest U.S. nuclear owner, bought gas-and-geothermal giant Calpine, creating the biggest U.S. power producer to sell to data centers and others. Equity price at signing was about $16.4B ($4.5B cash plus 50M shares) plus $12.7B of debt; the 10-K values the purchase at about $22B at closing on January 7, 2026 because the share price rose.
